description:
Create a NEW test suite in the connected project from a small set of existing test cases. `tcIds` accepts numeric ids, business keys (TC_123), OR plain test case NAMES — a name is resolved by searching the project (tc_list under the hood); an ambiguous name (multiple matches) or one with zero matches is reported back rather than guessed. NOTE: a suite can only hold test cases of ONE category (all manual OR all automated) — a mixed set is refused.

NAME: if `name` is omitted, this tool does NOT create anything yet — it resolves the test cases, SUGGESTS a suite name, and returns a preview. Show the user the suggested name and the resolved test cases, ask them to confirm it or give their own, then call suite_create again with `name` set (and the same `tcIds`) to actually create it. Requires a live connection.

name.description: Suite name. Omit to get a suggested name + preview first (does not create).

tcIds.description: Test case ids, business keys (TC_123), or plain names to include.

name: suite_create
title: Create a new suite from a few test cases
